藏品名称_EN: Henan tianmu, black glazed bowl with rust spots
藏品名称_ZN: 黒釉銹斑文碗（河南天目）
描述_EN: Black-glazed ceramics fired at kilns in northern China are often referred to as Henan tianmu. However, their production area was not necessarily limited to Henan Province, but extended north of the Yellow River. Typical examples are those bowls with persimmon colored markings on a black ground, such as this bowl.
描述_ZN: 在中国北方的窑场烧制的黑釉陶瓷通常被称为河南天目。 然而，其生产地区不一定限于河南省，而是延伸到黄河以北。 典型的例子是那些在黑地上有柿子色斑纹的碗，如这个碗。
